sources.name: p_schoolcompliance_s
sources.script:
source(allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false,
	format: 'parquet') ~>  p_schoolcompliance_s

typeProperties.script:
section Section1;
shared p_schoolcompliance_s = let AdfDoc = AzureStorage.DataLakeContents("https://growecdstorage.dfs.core.windows.net/giraffe/parquet/p_schoolcompliance_s.parquet"), Parquet = Parquet.Document(AdfDoc) in Parquet;
shared UserQuery = let  
    Source = #"p_schoolcompliance_s",  
  
    // Keep only required source columns  
    #"Selected Columns" = Table.SelectColumns(Source,{  
        "amount",  
        "id", 
        "registration_checklist",  
        "dsd_application_submission_date",  
        "dsd_grant_approved",  
        "is_dsd_grant_paid",  
        "dsd_status",  
        "effective_date",  
        "is_eligible_for_other_subsidy",  
        "expiry_date",  
        "grow_franchisee_commencement_date",  
        "is_npo_registered",  
        "npo_registration_date",  
        "npo_registration_number",  
        "number_of_childrens_registration",  
        "other_subsidy_end_date",  
        "other_subsidy_start_date",  
        "school_id",  
        "school_capacity"  
    }),  
  
    // Replace NULL text values  
    #"Replace NULL Text" =  
        Table.ReplaceValue(  
            #"Selected Columns",  
            "NULL",  
            "",  
            Replacer.ReplaceText,  
            {  
                "npo_registration_date",  
                "expiry_date",  
                "effective_date",  
                "npo_registration_number",  
                "other_subsidy_start_date",  
                "other_subsidy_end_date",  
                "grow_franchisee_commencement_date",  
                "dsd_application_submission_date"  
            }  
        ),  
  
    // Replace NULL numeric values  
    #"Replace NULL Numeric" =  
        Table.ReplaceValue(  
            #"Replace NULL Text",  
            "NULL",  
            "0",  
            Replacer.ReplaceText,  
            {  
                "number_of_childrens_registration",  
                "school_capacity",  
                "amount"  
            }  
        ),  
  
    // Clean invalid MySQL-style date  
    #"Clean Invalid Dates" =  
        Table.ReplaceValue(  
            #"Replace NULL Numeric",  
            "0000-00-00",  
            "",  
            Replacer.ReplaceText,  
            {"dsd_application_submission_date"}  
        ),  
  
    // Map DSD Status to Dataverse option set values  
    #"Transform DSD Status" =  
        Table.TransformColumns(  
            #"Clean Invalid Dates",  
            {  
                {"dsd_status", each  
                    if _ = "Registered" then "301220002"  
                    else if _ = "Gold/Full registration" then "301220006"  
                    else if _ = "Bronze registration" then "301220007"  
                    else if _ = "Expired" then "301220000"  
                    else if _ = "Application Submitted" then "301220001"  
                    else if _ = "Application Denied" then "301220005"  
                    else if _ = "Not Registered" then "301220003"  
                    else if _ = "Conditionally Registered" then "301220004"  
                    else _  
                }  
            }  
        ),  
  
    // Convert Yes/No fields to 1/0  
    #"Transform Yes No Fields" =  
        Table.TransformColumns(  
            #"Transform DSD Status",  
            {  
                {"is_dsd_grant_paid", each if Text.Lower(_) = "yes" then "1" else "0"},  
                {"dsd_grant_approved", each if Text.Lower(_) = "yes" then "1" else "0"},  
                {"is_npo_registered", each if Text.Lower(_) = "yes" then "1" else "0"},  
                {"is_eligible_for_other_subsidy", each if Text.Lower(_) = "yes" then "1" else "0"}  
            }  
        ),  
  
    // Rename to destination schema names  
    #"Renamed Columns" =  
        Table.RenameColumns(#"Transform Yes No Fields",{  
            {"amount", "tcbgrow_amountid"},
            {"id", "tcbgrow_appid"}, 
            {"registration_checklist", "tcbgrow_appidregistration_checklist"},  
            {"dsd_application_submission_date", "tcbgrow_checklistholderdsd_application_submission_date"},  
            {"dsd_grant_approved", "tcbgrow_dsdapplicationsubmissiondsd_grant_approved"},  
            {"is_dsd_grant_paid", "tcbgrow_dsdgrantapprovalis_dsd_grant_paid"},  
            {"dsd_status", "tcbgrow_dsdgrantpaiddsd_status"},  
            {"effective_date", "tcbgrow_dsdstatuseffective_date"},  
            {"is_eligible_for_other_subsidy", "tcbgrow_effectivedateis_eligible_for_other_subsidy"},  
            {"expiry_date", "tcbgrow_eligibleforotherstudyexpiry_date"},  
            {"grow_franchisee_commencement_date", "tcbgrow_franchisecommencementdate"},  
            {"is_npo_registered", "tcbgrow_franchisecommencementdateis_npo_registered"},  
            {"npo_registration_date", "tcbgrow_nporegisterednpo_registration_date"},  
            {"npo_registration_number", "tcbgrow_nporegistrationdatenpo_registration_number"},  
            {"number_of_childrens_registration", "tcbgrow_nporegistrationnumbernumber_of_childrens_registration"},  
            {"other_subsidy_end_date", "tcbgrow_numberofchildrensregistrationother_subsidy_end_date"},  
            {"other_subsidy_start_date", "tcbgrow_othersubsidyenddateother_subsidy_start_date"},  
            {"school_id", "tcbgrow_othersubsidystartdateschool_id"},  
            {"school_capacity", "tcbgrow_schoolcapacity"}  
        })  
  
in  
    #"Renamed Columns";
